visuals: The lush tropical rainforest of Taï National Park in Côte d'Ivoire with tall trees and dense green foliage. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: The land here feels like a giant nature park! Tropical forests like Taï National Park, grassy plains where antelopes roam, and rolling hills. The weather stays warm all year, with a rainy season and a dry one to mix things up.

visuals: The majestic Mount Nimba in Côte d'Ivoire surrounded by thick, misty jungle and unique mountain plants. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Now for my favorite natural gem… Mount Nimba! Way out west, this mountain is part of a UNESCO site where rare plants and animals thrive. It’s like a secret jungle lab!

visuals: Assinie-Mafia beach in CôTe D’Ivoire bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script:
And speaking of wildlife… meet the country’s most iconic resident: the elephant!
It’s actually the national symbol. In fact, the country's name means “Ivory Coast”, because huge numbers of elephants once lived here.

visuals: A group of chimpanzees swinging through the green canopy of a Côte d'Ivoire forest. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: You might see chimpanzees swinging through the trees.

visuals: A rare and shy pygmy hippo peeking from the deep shadows of a Côte d'Ivoire riverbank. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: But the real star is the rare pygmy hippo. It’s tiny, shy, and very special!

visuals: The massive Basilica of Our Lady of Peace in Yamoussoukro, Côte d'Ivoire, standing tall under a clear blue sky. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Can you name the capital? It’s Yamoussoukro! It’s home to the Basilica of Our Lady of Peace, one of the biggest churches in the world!

visuals: A wide view of the Abidjan lagoon in Côte d'Ivoire with small boats and the modern city skyline in the background. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: But wait, there’s more! Abidjan is the largest city. Its lagoon isn’t just pretty—it’s used for transport, fishing, and all kinds of trade.

visuals: Colorful market stalls in Bouaké, Côte d'Ivoire, filled with vibrant hand-woven textiles and local crafts. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Then there’s Bouaké, full of colorful crafts and textile markets that are a feast for the eyes.

visuals: The vibrant markets of Abidjan in CôTe D’Ivoire bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: French is the official language, but people here speak over 60 different languages! Bonjour, explorers!

visuals: The Basilica of Our Lady of Peace open courtyard in CôTe D’Ivoire bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: About 28 million people call this country home. That’s roughly the same as the population of Texas!

visuals: A fluffy plate of authentic Côte d'Ivoire attiéké (cassava) served with a large grilled fish and fresh onions. No text, no signs, no written words.
script:
Time to eat! Try attiéké!
A fluffy cassava dish that tastes amazing with grilled fish.

visuals: A street vendor's basket in Côte d'Ivoire filled with golden-fried alloco (sweet plantains) served on a rustic plate. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Craving a snack? Try alloco! These are sweet, golden-fried plantains that are crispy and popular in every neighborhood.

visuals: A farmer in a Côte d'Ivoire plantation collecting large yellow cocoa pods into a traditional basket. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Guess what? Côte d’Ivoire is the world’s top grower of cocoa. That’s the magical bean that becomes chocolate!

visuals: A dancer in a traditional, intricately carved mask performing the fast-paced Zaouli dance in a Côte d'Ivoire village. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Let’s move to the Zaouli dance! Dancers wear traditional masks and move their feet incredibly fast to tell ancient stories.

visuals: A traditional Côte d'Ivoire village festival at night with drummers playing and children clapping in a circle. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: At village festivals, drumming and storytelling bring the night to life. It’s music you can feel in your feet!

visuals: A soccer ball on a soccer field. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Here’s a moment to remember: in 2006, the national soccer team qualified for the World Cup for the first time. Their success lifted national pride and brought people together.

visuals: Côte d'Ivoire soccer legend Didier Drogba celebrating a goal on the pitch with fans cheering in the background. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: If you’re into sports, meet Didier Drogba, the soccer star who’s also known for helping unite people during hard times.

visuals: Côte d'Ivoire sprinter Murielle Ahouré racing on a professional track under the sun. No text, no signs, no written words.
script:
And don’t miss Murielle Ahouré!
West Africa’s fastest woman and a world medalist in sprinting!

visuals: A tropical street in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire, decorated for Christmas with palm trees wrapped in lights and artificial white snow. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And here’s one last surprise… when it’s hot in December, people use foam or cotton to make a “white Christmas.” Now that’s holiday creativity!
